name: rtl-cursor
description: Smart RTL for Cursor and Antigravity IDE (Chat, Agent, Plan, Canvas, and Markdown). Uses Vazirmatn only if installed and the user has not chosen another font. RTL text is right-aligned; code and LTR text stay left-to-right.

rtlCursor.autoReapply.description: After an editor update, re-apply the RTL patch automatically if you had it enabled

rtlCursor.autoRelaunch.description: After applying or removing the RTL patch, automatically quit and relaunch the editor so changes take effect without a manual Exit

rtlCursor.showStatusBar.description: نمایش دکمه وضعیت RTL در نوار وضعیت ادیتور
